movies.title: Fettered
movies.summary: In the gripping thriller Fettered, sixteen-year-old Paris from the Bronx wakes up completely disoriented in a dense, remote forest, chained to a tree and bleeding heavily from a gunshot wound. With no memory of how she got there or who attacked her, she is thrust into a desperate fight for survival against both her severe injuries and the unforgiving elements. To unlock the key to her escape and unmask her kidnapper, Paris must mentally piece together the hazy, fragmented memories of her final day at school before time runs out. Meanwhile, a frantic race against the clock unfolds back home as Paris's family and friends launch a high-stakes search to find her. As they exhaust every possible resource to track her location, the tension escalates into a dual battle against nature and a ticking clock. The searchers must piece together their own clues to reach Paris before she succumbs to blood loss—or before the sinister force lurking in the shadows of the woods finds her first.
